observation: Current pre-handoff and clean-machine APIs carry prehandoff_receipt_ref as a non-empty textual string but do not carry or verify an immutable digest of the external receipt content. The release manifest can therefore bind the name/reference while later clean-machine evidence still lacks a source-level content identity for the external receipt object itself.
counterhypothesis: If every admitted prehandoff_receipt_ref is already guaranteed by an external canonical store to be immutable/content-addressed and that guarantee is enforced before clean-machine validation, an additional receipt digest field may be redundant.
discriminator: Prove one of: (A) prehandoff_receipt_ref is mechanically content-addressed/immutable at the admitted storage boundary and clean-machine dereference verifies that invariant, or (B) add a canonical prehandoff_receipt_sha256/equivalent subject digest at matrix and per-observation level and reject same-ref/different-content substitution.
scope_boundary: does not modify WP1110 active pointer
does not modify canonical WP1110 implementation paths
does not mint a successor generation
does not claim target runtime or clean-machine failure
does not invalidate outer ZIP digest binding; it identifies an adjacent evidence-lineage requirement
